key_insight: BrainNet Studio unifies brain network construction, analysis, prediction, and visualization in one toolkit, extending beyond static connectomes to dynamic, spatiotemporal, and graph-based modeling.
engineering_relevance: It lowers the integration burden for computational neuroscience workflows by packaging 27 algorithms and a consistent pipeline for comparing methods, identifying biomarkers, and interpreting results.
method: Builds static and dynamic brain networks from structural and functional data.
Supports feature extraction, classification, biomarker discovery, and visualization with deep learning, GNNs, and sequence models.
Uses an LLM to generate researcher-verifiable summaries of connectivity and structure-function coupling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a unified toolkit with 27 integrated algorithms and validation through tasks such as classification, discriminative region/connection identification, and multi-level connectivity summarization.
watch_item: As with any broad integrated toolkit, results may depend on careful method selection, data quality, and verification of LLM-generated summaries.
paper_title: BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization
